programme.desc: 'S11/E2'. Die voormalige Springbok Andries Strauss deel sy rugbystories, van Grey Kollege tot internasionale vlak. Ons kry 'n paar gholfwenke en bespreek lewensversekering.

programme.title: Gesels
programme.desc: 'S7/E3'. Tamsyn Jack ontdek haar krag ná 'n eierstokkanker-diagnose. Leandie hoor haar storie. Plant-pel Andreas bring plantvrede. Herman rol 'n room-en-strooisuiker-fees op.

programme.title: Tuin en Spens
programme.desc: In hierdie dokumentêr deel die kunstenaar en skrywer, Louis Jansen van Vuuren, hoe jy 'n vegan-leefstyl maklik en lekker kan aanpak.

programme.title: Dr. Nou
programme.desc: 'S7/E11'. Chantele se skaamte oor haar tande het haar laat onttrek van mense en geleenthede. Sy wil nou vir haarself kies en 'n selfversekerde voorbeeld vir haar dogters wees.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E7'. Op 7 Julie, 1999 het drie onskuldige vriende uitgery om die natuurskoon van die Franschhoekpas te geniet. Sonder enige waarskuwing besluit 'n groep mans om hulle te beroof en grusaam om die lewe te bring...

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E8'. Jaydon Glazer en sy skoolmaat was eens op 'n tyd groot vriende gewees, maar ongelukkig het tienerhormone en ego's die vriendskap vernietig en plek gemaak vir wedywering, dreigemente en koelbloedige moord.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E9'. Vanaf sy eerste optrede as jongman in 'n kroeg, tot sy laaste optredes voor derduisende aanhangers, het Theuns Jordaan homself gevestig as 'n legende van Suid-Afrikaanse musiek.

programme.title: Huisgenoot: Ware Lewensdramas
programme.desc: 'S13/E10'. Nog 'n dag, nog 'n sinnelose en gruwelike plaasmoord. Terwyl die families en gemeenskap van Magogong naby Hartswater hulle lewens bymekaar probeer trek, hoop die land maar net vir enige antwoorde...

programme.title: Verander jou siening
programme.desc: 'S1/E3'. Morgen Briel, 'n jong dame met downsindroom, het 'n talent vir koekies bak. Die aktrise Mila Guy kry nie net 'n nuwe hondekoekieresep nie, maar ook 'n nuwe blik op iemand wat met downsindroom lewe.

programme.title: Middeljare-mojo Met Marna
programme.desc: 'S1/E6'. Levena Josephs se kragtige verhaal oor tweede kanse en hoe sy vir 'n doel gered is. Shahnaz onthul die geheime konneksie tussen beweging, jou ingesteldheid en 'n gloeiende vel.

programme.title: Landbouweekliks
programme.desc: 'S31/E9'. PF Theron se Dwars-in-die-weg-boerdery doen iets buitengewoon in die hartjie van die dorre Karoo buite Matjiesfontein in die Wes-Kaap. Hier is 'n hoogs gespesialiseerde groentesaadvermeerdering-onderneming aan die groei.

programme.title: Tydlose Skoonheid
programme.desc: 'S1/E2'. Gewone mense deel die inspirerende stories van hoe 'n gesonde leefstyl asook Zinplex-produkte hulle gehelp het om ouerword met meer elegansie en moed aan te pak.

programme.title: Verander jou siening

programme.title: Trepidation
programme.desc: A trip to the village triggers a woman's repressed childhood trauma, drawing her into a race against superstition, religion and dark forces for her mental health.

programme.title: In My Shoes
programme.desc: An older married woman facing long-standing marital troubles chooses to focus on herself, pursuing her dreams and prioritizing what truly makes her happy.

programme.title: Still Waters
programme.desc: Taiwo, a car dealer, captivated by Sarah, a politician's daughter, faces heartbreak when her affection turns cold. As he struggles, a glimmer of hope emerges.

programme.title: Talking Stage
programme.desc: Two friends find themselves attracted to the same man, so they come up with a plan to woo him to see who he will choose for a relationship.

programme.title: Fatal Obsession
programme.desc: Jide is a loving husband who becomes suspicious of his wife's behavior after she receives secretive messages and calls. Jide is torn between his love and his growing doubts.

programme.title: PTA
programme.desc: 'S1/E23'. As Kennedy and Nafiu set aside their differences. They continue to put pressure on Ayomide to confess. Tensions rise as a small glimmer of the truth is finally revealed.

programme.title: Greener Pastures
programme.desc: A devoted husband and father is being tormented by his wife and her sister after losing his job. He has to struggle on his own against the tides to find his feet.

programme.title: Green Is The New Love

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Captivating audiences around the world, Hiromi is one of Japan's leading pianists - exclusive backstage footage and a special performance reveal her musical world and the challenges behind it.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: We look at how Sendai has transformed into a disaster-resilient city with its 'multiple defences', countermeasures taken in its coastal area to minimise damage from a tsunami.

programme.title: Clothes That Transcend Time
programme.desc: Akita / Koike Kazuko (Creative Director): The Nishimonai Bon Odori Festival has been held for over 700 years - Koike finds timeless beauty in its costumes remade using beloved family kimonos.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Samurai Wisdom
programme.desc: Always seeking the ideal master, samurai Todo Takatora was a skilled castlebuilder and a man of flexibility and rationality who saw the changes to come.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture - explore the unique culture behind them. This episode looks at words related to trees.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
programme.desc: Yoshida Ryusei, an October matsuri, features rockets called ryusei that are made by local teams and carry community prayers high in the sky - team members pour heart and soul into their efforts.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: The Forger Who Fooled The World
programme.desc: Wolfgang Beltracchi, who scammed collectors and museums out of huge sums of money, is one of the most notorious forgers of all time - we look at a scandal that shook the art world to its core.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Demolition Kingdom
programme.desc: We follow the demolition of Japan's World Trade Center building at 162m - craftsmen take on the highest demolition in history with world-first new techniques.

programme.title: Framing Everyday's Moments
programme.desc: A unique time-lapse photography project, shot by pros and non-pros from around the world, on the transience of nature, celestial phenomena, cityscapes and each single moment of everyday life.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Tiny Desk Concerts Japan
programme.desc: One of Tokyo's most talked-about emerging trios, CHO CO PA CO CHO CO QUIN QUIN, comes to tiny desk - the performance also features special guest artists U-zhaan, Nii Tete Boye and Hajime Chitose.

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Animation series about a Japanese dog who meets and is helped by many mythical creatures of northern Japan as he searches for eight star talismans.

programme.title: Japanology Plus Mini
programme.desc: Japan is a hot spot for discovering dinosaur fossils - an excavation in Hokkaido sparked a nationwide enthusiasm for dinosaurs and led to entertainment such as dinosaur robots and mechanical suits.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: Chibita is a friendly cat living at a souvenir shop near Chusonji Temple - a World Heritage Site - Popo lives at a horseback riding club with 20 horses, and we meet handsome Kikujiro at a rose garden.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Anime Manga Explosion
programme.desc: Yamashita Shingo is known for naruto key animation and jujutsu kaisen openings - go behind the scenes of a new feature of his, Cosmic Princess Kaguya!, and see him use cutting-edge tools to create.

programme.title: Rockie And Her Friends
programme.desc: Puppet action show for children. In a distant post-human future where surviving creatures have formed a community, new-breed dinosaur girl Rockie sets out on hilarious adventures with her schoolmates.

programme.desc: Learn programming principles without a computer! Animated characters provide fun and lucid explanations of five core processes: analysis, combination, generalisation, abstraction and simulation.
